schema_note: Chapter-local review-queue candidates only. This file is NOT the global research/scope/review_queue.json - it is merged into that coordinator-maintained file after this chapter passes validation.

items.title: Two omitted parent headings and incorrect TOC attachments
items.summary: Canonical TOC/body OCR confirms that Basic Anatomy, common presentations, PFTs, CXR, and ABGs belong beneath the omitted 'Approach to the Respiratory Patient' heading; Sleep Hypoventilation and Sleep Apnea belong beneath the omitted 'Sleep-Related Breathing Disorders' heading, not Neoplasms. Airway Disease starts at R7, not R3.
items.recommended_action: Preserve the chapter-local UNCATALOGUED hierarchy and corrected exact page ranges; repair toc_inventory.json only in a separate global TOC-maintenance task.

items.title: Substantial ABG and ILD headings absent from toc_inventory.json
items.summary: Targeted body OCR confirms standalone Arterial Blood Gases, Hypersensitivity Pneumonitis, Sarcoidosis, Pneumoconioses, and Drug/Treatment-Associated ILD headings. They were recovered with synthetic IDs and kept within their verified page ranges.
items.recommended_action: Retain these source-traceable units; do not collapse them back into inaccurate broad inventory nodes.

items.title: No dedicated MCC objective for solitary pulmonary nodule
items.summary: Targeted canonical registry searches for pulmonary nodule, lung cancer, and abnormal chest imaging returned no dedicated objective. Objective 7 (Hemoptysis) supports CT evaluation for bronchogenic malignancy only indirectly, so evidence remains WEAK with requires_scope_review=true.
items.recommended_action: Recheck after future MCC registry refresh; keep detailed nodule algorithms in the linked Imaging/Thoracic Surgery scope and verify current thresholds during question generation.

items.title: Respiratory recognition retained across explicit cross-references
items.summary: Several R nodes explicitly defer to Pediatrics, Cardiology, Thoracic Surgery, Medical Imaging, Rheumatology, Nephrology, or occupational medicine. R retains presentation recognition, stabilization, basic testing, and referral where source/MCC evidence supports it; no PRIMARY_OWNER/CROSS_LINK/DISTINCT_CONTEXT decision was made.
items.recommended_action: Resolve global ownership only after all chapters are mapped.

items.title: Volatile respiratory treatment thresholds and regimens
items.summary: The chapter contains inhaler sequences, oxygen/ventilation targets, anticoagulant and antimicrobial regimens, pleural and nodule thresholds, sepsis protocols, and medication doses that must not be frozen at scope stage.
items.recommended_action: During question generation, retrieve current Canadian guidance source-first and verify every exact threshold, dose, sequence, and schedule.
